expectations.text: Uses `--to test` flag to stop before deploy
expectations.evidence: Primary recommendation: `kde proj pipeline backend --to test`
`--to test` alone is sufficient and is the primary recommendation

expectations.text: Correctly names the project (`backend`) in the command
Does NOT suggest running deploy stage when user explicitly wants to skip it
Explains what the flag does (stopping at test stage)
expectations.evidence: Explains: `--to test` 會從第一個 stage 開始執行，跑完 test 就停止，deploy 不會被執行
